about: Names and descriptions for the Music view (musiclist.py). Items list their parts by condition ('match': state group -> value, using the names in names.json or the raw id), by cue id ('cue') or by plain sound id ('sound'). Combat items are generated per faction from 'roles'; a faction's 'roles' add to a role's description in its section. Other names a piece goes by come from labels.json ('Also called'); notes.json describes single clips. Sources are listed in the app's Credits.

sections.name: On the Ship
sections.about: Music on the Super Destroyer, before and between missions.

sections.name: Before the Drop
sections.about: From stepping into the hellpod to landing on the planet.
One section per enemy faction (see factions).

sections.name: Objectives
sections.about: Short cues for completed objectives, and the flag raising.

sections.name: Extraction
sections.about: From calling the pelican to leaving the planet.

sections.name: After the Mission
sections.about: The mission end, a failed mission and the way back to the ship.

sections.name: Training
sections.about: The training mission (music_tutorial_v2). Most of these pieces have no name yet.

sections.name: Not Identified Yet
sections.about: Music with no known place in the game yet. Each entry names the game state that starts it.

sections.name: Unused: Old Training
sections.about: Music for the old training mission (music_tutorial_old). The game probably doesn't play it any more.

factions.name: Hive World
factions.about: Combat music on Terminid hive worlds (music_enemy_bugs_hiveworld). Much of it is shared with the main Terminid music.

factions.name: Cyborgs
factions.about: A second set of Automaton combat music (music_enemy_cyborgs_02), also called bot world music.

factions.name: Illuminate Void
factions.about: Combat music on Illuminate Void missions (music_enemy_illuminates_rift). Much of it is shared with the main Illuminate music.

roles.death: Void missions play the regular Illuminate death music. The Void death music is in the game files, but nothing plays it.

arrival.name: Arrival
arrival.about: Calm music that sets the scene after landing (music_scene_setter), also called the battleground intro. Each biome has a separate part.

exploring.name: Exploring
exploring.about: Plays while no enemies are engaging. The part depends on the intensity: stealth (fighting undetected, or enemies searching), calm (approaching an outpost) and calm transition.

battle.name: Battle
battle.about: Plays during a fight, also called common battle.

intense.name: Intense Battle
intense.about: Plays at the highest combat intensity.

respawn.name: Respawn
respawn.about: Short bumpers on a respawn (music_respawn), also called reinforcement stingers.

death.name: Death
death.about: Plays on death, until the respawn.

stingers.name: Stingers
stingers.about: Short phrases over the music at certain moments.

transitions.name: Transitions
transitions.about: Short pieces between two parts of the music. They play the original until replaced or skipped. Transitions into a fight are also called battle stingers, and those out of it calm stingers.

items.name: Bridge and War Map
items.about: Music at the galactic war map, in three layers that play together (music, war-map music and a white-noise bed). The second part opens with a short piece for travelling to an operation (also called 'Travel to New Operation'). The two parts share most of the audio.

items.name: FTL Jump
items.about: Plays over the bridge music when the destroyer jumps to another system (also called 'warping to a system').

items.name: Loadout Background Stinger
items.about: A stinger over the bridge music, linked to picking a loadout.

items.name: Loading Into the Ship
items.about: Plays once on loading into the ship. There are three intros, one per camera.

items.name: Destroyer View
items.about: Also called 'view destroyer cue'.

items.name: Stepping Into the Hellpod
items.about: Leads from the bridge music into the loadout or drop-location music (also called 'Hellpod Entered').

items.name: Loadout Selection
items.about: Plays after the drop location screen and continues from where that music left off, in loops #1 to #14. The start segment plays only when the loadout screen opens straight from the ship.

items.name: Drop Location Selection
items.about: From the ship, the start segment plays once, then #1 to #14 loop in order. Back from the loadout screen, the loops continue from where that music left off.

items.name: Between Loadout and Drop Location
items.about: Short pieces on switching between the loadout and drop-location screens.

items.name: Stepping Out of the Hellpod
items.about: Leads back to the bridge music on leaving the hellpod (also called 'Hellpod Exit').

items.name: Hellpod Descent
items.about: Plays while the hellpod falls to the planet.

items.name: Hellpod Landing
items.about: Plays as the hellpod lands, leading into the mission music (also called 'Hellpod Land Cue').

items.name: Main Objective Complete
items.about: Plays when a main objective is completed.

items.name: Secondary Objective Complete
items.about: Plays when a secondary objective or outpost is done, at low intensity only. During a fight the combat music keeps going.

items.name: Calling Extraction
items.about: Leads from whatever is playing into the extraction music (also called 'Extraction Cue').

items.name: Extraction
items.about: Plays from calling the pelican until it lands. It has an intro, then two blocks of six segments. Each stem switches between calm and intense audio.

items.name: Pelican Landed
items.about: Plays once the pelican has landed and waits.

items.name: Pelican Liftoff
items.about: Plays as the pelican takes off.

items.name: Mission End
items.about: Plays after the pelican takes off, into the mission results (music_extraction_takeoff).

items.name: Mission Failed
items.about: Plays when a mission fails (music_mission_failure). The same audio plays for every enemy faction, at the end of the mission and on the stats screen.

items.name: Stats Screen
items.about: Plays on the stats screen (music_stats_screen).

items.name: Platform Rise
items.about: Also called 'Mission End Platform Rise (success)'.

items.name: Back to the Ship
items.about: Leads from the mission end back to the bridge music (also called 'Pelican Return to the ship').

items.name: Credits
items.about: Four songs in order.
